material_status.basis: Hawking's primary theorem with a modern uniqueness/rigidity scope review.

records.preferred_label: Hawking black-hole rigidity theorem in the analytic nondegenerate stationary rotating case

statement.conclusion: There is a commuting axial Killing field with closed orbits and horizon generator chi = t + Omega_H phi; the solution is stationary-axisymmetric.
hypotheses: four-dimensional analytic spacetime
asymptotically flat stationary vacuum Einstein solution
rotating black hole
regular connected nondegenerate event horizon
standard domain-of-outer-communications and global hypotheses of the theorem
statement.natural_language: A four-dimensional analytic asymptotically flat stationary rotating vacuum black-hole spacetime with a regular connected nondegenerate event horizon and the standard global hypotheses admits an axial Killing field commuting with the stationary Killing field, and the horizon generator is their constant angular-velocity combination.
statement.scope: Narrow analytic vacuum variant. Electrovac, degenerate horizons and full smooth global generality require separate claims; this is not the complete no-hair/Kerr-Newman uniqueness theorem.

material_status.basis: Primary theorem source under the frozen local vacuum hypotheses.

records.preferred_label: Jebsen-Birkhoff theorem in four-dimensional vacuum general relativity

statement.conclusion: Every point has a neighborhood isometric to a member of the Schwarzschild family; the additional Killing field is timelike only in a static exterior region, so no global-staticity claim across horizons is made.
hypotheses: four-dimensional C2 Lorentzian spacetime
spherical symmetry
vacuum Einstein equation R_ab = 0
cosmological constant Lambda = 0
statement.natural_language: Every C2 four-dimensional spherically symmetric Lorentzian solution of the vacuum Einstein equations with zero cosmological constant is locally a Schwarzschild solution and admits the corresponding additional hypersurface-orthogonal Killing symmetry.
statement.scope: Local 4D vacuum-GR variant. Schwarzschild-(A)dS, matter-coupled and modified-gravity variants are excluded and require separate claims.

material_status.basis: Buckingham's primary dimensional-analysis theorem.

statement.conclusion: For a basis a_j of ker(D), pi_j = product_i q_i^(a_ij) gives n-r independent dimensionless groups and the relation is equivalent to Phi(pi_1,...,pi_(n-r))=0.
hypotheses: n nonzero quantities q_i, positive when arbitrary real powers are used
dimension matrix D of rank r
relation invariant under the r-dimensional group of base-unit rescalings
regularity/domain restricted to one component where the selected monomials are valid
statement.natural_language: If a dimensionally homogeneous relation among n nonzero dimensional quantities is invariant under r independent base-unit rescalings and the dimension matrix has rank r, the relation can be expressed in terms of n-r independent dimensionless monomials spanning the kernel of that matrix.
statement.scope: Representation theorem only; it does not determine the function Phi. Rank, rather than an informal count of named units, controls n-r.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary proof under the explicitly frozen S-matrix assumptions.

statement.conclusion: The connected symmetry group has no nontrivial mixing of spacetime and internal generators beyond a local direct product.
hypotheses: 3+1-dimensional Poincare-invariant positive-energy scattering theory
finitely many one-particle species below every finite mass
nontrivial scattering at almost all energies
the paper's analyticity and regularity assumptions
ordinary, ungraded Lie symmetry
statement.natural_language: For a nontrivial analytic relativistic S-matrix in 3+1 dimensions satisfying the Coleman-Mandula assumptions, every connected ordinary bosonic Lie symmetry of the S-matrix is locally a direct product of the Poincare group and an internal symmetry group.
statement.scope: Does not cover graded Lie superalgebras; supersymmetry is a loophole/extension, not a counterexample. The theorem is not asserted for theories lacking the required S-matrix or particle-spectrum assumptions.

material_status.basis: Primary lattice-gauge proof with exact applicability conditions.

records.preferred_label: Elitzur's theorem for lattice gauge theories

statement.conclusion: The observable's expectation is zero, so local gauge symmetry cannot spontaneously break through a local gauge-noninvariant order parameter in this scope.
hypotheses: lattice statistical gauge model
compact local gauge group
gauge-invariant local action and measure
no gauge fixing
no explicit gauge-symmetry-breaking source
local observable with zero one-site Haar average
statement.natural_language: In a lattice gauge theory with compact local gauge group, gauge-invariant local action and measure, and neither gauge fixing nor an explicit symmetry-breaking source, every local observable whose Haar average under a gauge transformation at one site vanishes has zero expectation value.
statement.scope: Original lattice/compact-group form. Gauge-fixed remnant symmetries, global symmetries and unrestricted continuum formulations are excluded.

material_status.basis: Friedel's primary result with the Anderson-model paper used only to delimit an interacting variant.

records.preferred_label: Friedel phase-shift sum rule for a localized scatterer

statement.conclusion: Delta N(E_F) = (1/pi) sum_alpha g_alpha delta_alpha(E_F) in the selected convention.
hypotheses: noninteracting Fermi gas at T = 0
localized sufficiently short-range one-body scatterer
well-defined scattering channels and phase shifts
fixed continuous phase convention incorporating bound-state spectral flow
Fermi energy away from a singular threshold
statement.natural_language: At zero temperature, for a noninteracting Fermi gas perturbed by a localized sufficiently short-range one-body potential, the impurity-induced excess number of occupied states below the Fermi energy equals the sum of scattering phase shifts at the Fermi energy divided by pi, with channel degeneracies and bound-state jumps included by the fixed continuous phase convention.
statement.scope: Single-particle localized-scatterer form. Anderson-impurity and other interacting generalizations require their own Fermi-liquid hypotheses.

material_status.basis: Original result and peer-reviewed theorem proof.

records.preferred_label: Goldstone theorem for spontaneously broken continuous global symmetry

statement.conclusion: A massless excitation couples to the broken current.
hypotheses: local relativistic QFT
exact continuous global internal symmetry
conserved current j_a^mu
Poincare-invariant vacuum and spectrum condition
some local field Phi with <0|[Q_a,Phi(0)]|0> nonzero
statement.natural_language: In a local relativistic quantum field theory with an exact continuous global internal symmetry, conserved current, Poincare-invariant vacuum and the usual locality and spectrum assumptions, a nonzero vacuum expectation of the commutator of the charge with a local field forces zero-mass support in the current-field spectral function.
statement.scope: Relativistic global-symmetry form. Local gauge symmetry, explicit breaking and general nonrelativistic counting are excluded; Coleman's 1+1-dimensional obstruction is a scope-limiting related theorem.

material_status.basis: Primary theorem source plus independent analysis of the assumptions and conclusion.

records.preferred_label: Haag's theorem in scalar Wightman-field form

statement.conclusion: A genuinely interacting Wightman field cannot be exactly unitarily equivalent to the free Fock field through the naive interaction picture.
hypotheses: scalar Wightman fields
Poincare covariance and spectrum condition
unique vacuum and irreducibility assumptions
time-independent unitary intertwining the required equal-time field and conjugate/time-derivative data
statement.natural_language: If a free scalar Wightman field and another scalar field satisfying the corresponding covariance, spectrum, unique-vacuum and irreducibility assumptions are related by a time-independent unitary that implements the required equal-time interaction-picture equivalence, then the second field has the free two-point function and is itself free.
statement.scope: Scalar Wightman version. Gauge, cutoff, finite-volume, algebraic and other variants require separate scopes; the theorem does not invalidate perturbative renormalized calculations.

material_status.basis: Hawking's theorem and a later regularity analysis under the frozen hypotheses.

records.preferred_label: Hawking area theorem for classical future event horizons

statement.conclusion: Area(S2) >= Area(S1).

future completeness or the applicable predictability condition for generators
null convergence R_ab k^a k^b >= 0 for every null k
ordered compact spacelike cross-sections S1 preceding S2
statement.natural_language: For a sufficiently regular classical future event horizon satisfying the required predictability or future-completeness hypotheses and the null convergence condition, the area of later compact spacelike horizon cross-sections is not smaller than the area of earlier ones.
statement.scope: Classical event horizons in the theorem's causal/regularity regime. Semiclassical Hawking evaporation and the generalized second law are excluded.

material_status.basis: Primary Kallen and Lehmann spectral-representation sources.

statement.conclusion: There is a positive measure rho on nonnegative mass-squared such that <0|phi(x)phi*(0)|0> = integral rho(d mu^2) Delta_+(x;mu^2), and the Feynman propagator has the corresponding spectral integral; a stable one-particle state contributes a pole delta term plus continuum.

Poincare-covariant relativistic QFT
unique invariant vacuum
spectrum condition
scalar field phi with well-defined vacuum two-point distribution
statement.natural_language: In a positive-metric relativistic QFT satisfying Poincare covariance, vacuum uniqueness and the spectrum condition, the vacuum two-point distribution of a scalar field is a positive spectral superposition of free two-point functions.
statement.scope: Positive-metric scalar form. No unconditional normalization integral rho=1 is asserted, and indefinite-metric gauge fields require separate variants.

material_status.basis: Primary finite-configuration impossibility proof.

statement.conclusion: No such valuation exists.
hypotheses: real or complex Hilbert space H with dim(H) >= 3
valuation v on all rank-one projectors with values in {0,1}
the value of a projector is independent of the measurement context
for every orthonormal basis projector family (P_i), sum_i v(P_i) = 1
statement.natural_language: On a real or complex Hilbert space of dimension at least three, no noncontextual deterministic 0/1 valuation of every rank-one projector can assign exactly one value 1 to each complete orthonormal-basis projector family.
statement.scope: Projective-measurement contextuality theorem. Bell locality, CHSH and GHZ claims are separate.

material_status.basis: Kohn's peer-reviewed primary theorem.

statement.conclusion: The center-of-mass cyclotron pole occurs at omega_c = |eB|/m and is not shifted by the interactions.
hypotheses: particles share one charge-to-mass ratio e/m
quadratic/Galilean-invariant kinetic energy
uniform magnetic field
interactions depend only on relative coordinates and preserve translation invariance
spatially uniform long-wavelength probe
statement.natural_language: For interacting particles with the same charge-to-mass ratio, quadratic continuum dispersion and translation-invariant interactions depending only on relative coordinates in a uniform magnetic field, center-of-mass cyclotron motion decouples and its resonance frequency is the bare cyclotron frequency independent of the interactions.
statement.scope: Continuum Galilean-invariant form. Lattice bands, nonparabolic dispersion, disorder and unequal charge-to-mass ratios can evade the conclusion.

material_status.basis: Original result and independent theorem exposition.

statement.conclusion: For every eigenvector psi, Theta psi is an orthogonal eigenvector with the same eigenvalue; finite eigenspace dimensions are even.
hypotheses: self-adjoint H on a complex Hilbert space
antiunitary Theta preserves the domain of H
H Theta = Theta H
Theta squared = -I
statement.natural_language: If a self-adjoint Hamiltonian commutes with a domain-preserving antiunitary time-reversal operator whose square is minus the identity, each eigenvector has an orthogonal partner at the same eigenvalue and every finite-multiplicity eigenvalue has even multiplicity.
statement.scope: Time-reversal-odd-square theorem; it is not a statement about generic degeneracy or all time-reversal symmetries.

material_status.basis: Exact algebraic consequence of the frozen scaling and matching assumptions, sourced to the original mechanism and modern review.

records.preferred_label: Kibble-Zurek freeze-out scaling for a linear quench

statement.conclusion: |t_hat| scales as tau0^(1/(1+z nu)) tau_Q^(z nu/(1+z nu)); xi_hat scales as xi0 (tau_Q/tau0)^(nu/(1+z nu)); a codimension-c defect density scales as xi_hat^-c under the domain estimate.
hypotheses: linear quench epsilon(t)=t/tau_Q
equilibrium critical scaling xi=xi0|epsilon|^-nu
critical slowing down tau=tau0|epsilon|^-znu
freeze-out defined by tau(epsilon_hat)=|epsilon_hat/dot epsilon|
independent-domain estimate and explicitly fixed defect codimension when defect density is claimed
statement.natural_language: For a linear quench epsilon(t)=t/tau_Q through a continuous critical point with equilibrium xi=xi0|epsilon|^-nu and relaxation time tau=tau0|epsilon|^-znu, the adiabatic-impulse matching condition yields freeze-out time proportional to tau_Q^(z nu/(1+z nu)) and length proportional to tau_Q^(nu/(1+z nu)); independent-domain defect estimates inherit the corresponding inverse-length power.
statement.scope: Model-internal adiabatic-impulse consequence. Nonlinear quenches, inhomogeneity, finite size, coarsening and beyond-KZ dynamics require separate variants; empirical universality is not inherited.

material_status.basis: Scholarly proof-and-scope review of the scattering theorem and its exceptions.

records.preferred_label: Levinson theorem for three-dimensional short-range central-potential scattering

statement.conclusion: delta_l(0) - delta_l(infinity) = n_l pi for every partial wave l.
hypotheses: three-dimensional Schrodinger scattering
real central potential regular at the origin and sufficiently short range
standard phase convention with delta_l(infinity)=0
no zero-energy half-bound state or threshold resonance in the selected simple variant
statement.natural_language: For three-dimensional nonrelativistic scattering by a real regular sufficiently short-range central potential with no zero-energy half-bound state, the change of the l-th partial-wave phase shift from zero to infinite energy is pi times the number of bound states in that angular-momentum channel.
statement.scope: Simple no-threshold-resonance variant. Half-bound states add the appropriate correction and two-dimensional, relativistic and Aharonov-Bohm variants are separate.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary theorem.

statement.conclusion: There are interaction- and geometry-dependent C, mu, v > 0 such that ||[tau_t(A),B]|| <= C ||A|| ||B|| s(X,Y) exp(-mu(d(X,Y)-v|t|)), with the support factor convention fixed by the selected variant.

finite-dimensional on-site Hilbert spaces
finite-range or finite exponential/F-norm interaction
finite disjoint supports X and Y
local observables A in A_X and B in A_Y

statement.scope: Many-body locality bound. It gives an effective rather than strictly zero propagation cone, and constants are not universal.

material_status.basis: Original many-body proof and independent topological formulation used to bound the scope.

normal Fermi-liquid or adiabatically connected nonfractionalized phase
fixed primitive-cell and spin/flavor conventions
statement.natural_language: At zero temperature in a translationally invariant particle-number-conserving normal Fermi liquid without translation breaking or topological order, the total oriented Fermi-sea volume, with all spin/flavor degeneracies counted, equals the filling modulo filled bands.
statement.scope: Ordinary Fermi-liquid scope. Fractionalized/topologically ordered phases and the one-dimensional Luttinger-liquid entity are excluded.

material_status.basis: The two primary topological proofs.

translation invariance
finite-range or sufficiently local couplings
regular isolated nodes on a compact Brillouin torus
the exact chiral setup of the theorem

statement.scope: Lattice no-go theorem. Wilson, staggered and Ginsparg-Wilson constructions alter hypotheses and are not counterexamples.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary characterization theorem.

density-operator family S
one CPTP map B
for every rho in S both output marginals equal rho

material_status.basis: OS-II extends and corrects the earlier sufficiency conditions, so both historical and corrected sources are pinned.

statement.scope: Corrected scalar/bosonic OS-II scope. Reflection positivity alone is insufficient, and fermionic/gauge variants need separate axioms.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary no-go proof with preparation independence retained explicitly.

statement.conclusion: Distinct pure-state measures have zero ontic overlap; no psi-epistemic model satisfying these assumptions reproduces all targeted quantum statistics.

statement.scope: Preparation-independent ontological-model no-go result. It is not an assumption-free declaration that the wavefunction is objectively real.

material_status.basis: Kato's theorem plus an explicit quantitative bound for the selected smooth gapped variant.

a uniform gap g > 0 separates its band from the rest of the spectrum
U_T solves i partial_s U_T = T H(s) U_T with U_T(0)=I

statement.scope: Finite-dimensional uniformly gapped quantitative variant. Gapless, unbounded and infinite-volume variants are not covered.

material_status.basis: Primary theorem and an independent modern QFT review.

statement.conclusion: The linear span of local field polynomials applied to Omega is dense; equivalently Omega is cyclic for A(O). With locality and nonempty causal complement, separating is a corollary.

nonempty open spacetime region O
test functions supported in O
statement.natural_language: In the vacuum sector of a Minkowski Wightman quantum field theory, applying fields smeared inside any nonempty open spacetime region to the vacuum generates a dense subspace.
statement.scope: Vacuum-sector Wightman/local-algebra cyclicity. Operational state preparation and superluminal signaling claims do not follow.

material_status.basis: Primary proof read together with its published correction.

global hyperbolicity of the relevant domain

the causal and generic conditions in the corrected theorem

statement.scope: Corrected asymptotically flat theorem. It is distinct from weak/strong cosmic censorship and does not assert that the entire spacetime topology is trivial.

the measurement is exact

statement.scope: Bounded/discrete theorem. Approximate bounds and continuous/unbounded-observable variants are separate.

material_status.basis: Bargmann's rigorous proof of Wigner's symmetry theorem.

material_status.basis: The lattice and fixpoint soundness construction is proved in the foundational paper.

material_status.basis: Kearns, Schapire, and Sellie supply the primary agnostic-learning model, and the cited statistical-learning reference states the finite-VC-dimension characterization for the separately scoped agnostic binary model.

material_status.basis: The primary paper proves the model-relative oracle barrier.

statement.scope: Complexity-theoretic proof barrier; it does not assert that every technique using algebra is impossible.

material_status.basis: The primary paper proves the estimator moment bounds and amplification.

material_status.basis: The two oracle constructions are proved in the primary paper.

statement.scope: Deterministic and nondeterministic polynomial-time oracle Turing machines.

material_status.basis: The primary source proves completeness and quantitative soundness of the self-test.

material_status.basis: The result follows by finite exhaustion under the explicit SyGuS/CEGIS contract.

material_status.basis: Cook's theorem and corrigendum prove the stated relative-completeness result.

material_status.basis: The primary paper proves the oracle separation.

statement.scope: Model-relative barrier; it is not an unconditional separation between symmetric and public-key cryptography.

material_status.basis: The equality is the main theorem of the primary source.

statement.conclusion: MIP* = RE.
hypotheses: Completeness, soundness, verifier, and entangled-strategy conventions are those fixed in the primary paper
statement.natural_language: The class of languages with multiprover interactive proofs whose provers may share entanglement equals the class of recursively enumerable languages.
statement.scope: Classical polynomial-time verifier with noncommunicating entangled provers.

material_status.basis: If P equaled NP, the associated polynomially balanced inversion relation could be solved sufficiently to contradict one-wayness.

records.preferred_label: One-way functions imply P does not equal NP

statement.conclusion: P != NP.
hypotheses: A standard length-regular uniform one-way function exists
Inversion success is measured over the function's prescribed efficiently samplable input distribution
Adversaries are uniform PPT
statement.natural_language: If a length-regular polynomial-time computable one-way function exists against the fixed probabilistic polynomial-time inversion model, then P does not equal NP.
statement.scope: Uniform classical worst-case classes and average-case inversion security under the fixed OWF definition.

material_status.basis: The membership and hardness reductions are standard results documented in the cited reference.

statement.conclusion: Parameterized k-Clique is W[1]-complete.
hypotheses: Input is a finite simple graph and integer k
Parameter is k
Reductions are standard fpt many-one reductions
statement.natural_language: The parameterized problem that asks whether a graph contains a clique of size k, parameterized by k, is complete for W[1] under fixed-parameter tractable many-one reductions.
statement.scope: Classical parameterized decision complexity.

material_status.basis: The learnability characterization is proved in the primary source.

records.preferred_label: Realizable PAC learnability and finite VC dimension equivalence

statement.conclusion: PAC learnability is equivalent to finite VC dimension.
hypotheses: Binary classification
IID examples
Realizable labels
Distribution-free PAC criterion
The standard measurability assumptions
statement.natural_language: Under the standard measurability conditions, a binary concept class is distribution-free PAC learnable in the realizable case if and only if it has finite VC dimension.
statement.scope: Realizable PAC learning; agnostic learning and exact sample bounds are separate variants.

material_status.basis: The combinatorial bound is proved independently in the cited primary sources.

statement.conclusion: |F| <= sum_{i=0}^d binomial(n,i).
hypotheses: F is a family of subsets of a finite n-element ground set
VCdim(F)=d
statement.natural_language: If a family F of subsets of an n-element set has VC dimension d, then |F| is at most the sum from i=0 through d of binomial(n,i).
statement.scope: Finite set systems.

material_status.basis: The multiplicative-weights potential argument is proved in the primary paper.

statement.conclusion: For every expert i, M <= (ln(1/beta)/ln(2/(1+beta))) m_i + ln(N)/ln(2/(1+beta)).
hypotheses: Binary outcomes and expert predictions
Initial expert weights are equal
After each error an expert's weight is multiplied by beta
The algorithm predicts by current weighted majority
statement.natural_language: For N binary experts, Weighted Majority with penalty beta in (0,1) makes at most [ln(1/beta)/ln(2/(1+beta))] times the mistakes of any fixed expert plus ln(N)/ln(2/(1+beta)) mistakes.
statement.scope: Full-information mistake-bound protocol; Hedge losses and bandit feedback are separate.

material_status.basis: Classical module-over-a-PID structure theorem.

records.preferred_label: Structure theorem for finitely generated abelian groups

statement.conclusion: There are unique r≥0 and unique integers 1<n₁|⋯|n_k such that G≅Z^r⊕Z/n₁Z⊕⋯⊕Z/n_kZ.
hypotheses: G is a finitely generated abelian group
statement.natural_language: 每个有限生成阿贝尔群唯一分解为自由部分与满足整除链的有限循环群直和。
statement.scope: Invariant-factor form; uniqueness is up to the displayed numerical invariants.

material_status.basis: Classical Krull-Schmidt theorem in a safe finite-length scope.

statement.conclusion: M has a finite indecomposable direct-sum decomposition, and any two such decompositions have the same number of terms matched up to permutation and isomorphism.
hypotheses: M is a module of finite length
statement.natural_language: 有限长度模可分解为有限个不可分解模的直和，且该分解在置换与同构意义下唯一。
statement.scope: Finite-length module variant; broader categorical versions require separate hypotheses.

material_status.basis: Serre's GAGA theorem.

statement.conclusion: Analytification Coh(X)→Coh(X^{an}) is an equivalence of categories.
hypotheses: X is a projective scheme over C
statement.natural_language: 复数域上的射影概形的相干代数层与其解析化上的相干解析层由解析化函子给出等价。
statement.scope: Coherent-sheaf equivalence form; individual cohomology-comparison consequences are not counted again.

material_status.basis: Serre's coherent-sheaf duality theorem in a standard exact scope.

statement.conclusion: The trace pairing H^i(X,E)×H^{n−i}(X,E^∨⊗ω_X)→k is perfect.
hypotheses: X is a smooth projective n-dimensional variety over a field k
E is a vector bundle on X
ω_X is the canonical bundle
statement.natural_language: 光滑射影 n 维簇上向量丛的第 i 上同调与其对偶扭正则层的第 n−i 上同调互为线性对偶。
statement.scope: Smooth-projective vector-bundle form; broader proper-duality statements are separate variants.

material_status.basis: First direction of the fundamental theorem of calculus.

records.preferred_label: Fundamental theorem of calculus, differentiation part

statement.conclusion: F is differentiable on (a,b) and F′(x)=f(x).
hypotheses: f:[a,b]→R is continuous
F(x)=∫_a^x f(t)dt
statement.natural_language: 连续函数从固定端点到变量端点的积分是该函数的一个原函数。
statement.scope: Continuous real-valued one-variable form.

material_status.basis: Evaluation direction of the fundamental theorem of calculus.

records.preferred_label: Fundamental theorem of calculus, evaluation part

statement.conclusion: ∫_a^b f(x)dx=A(b)−A(a).
hypotheses: f:[a,b]→R is continuous
A is differentiable on (a,b), continuous on [a,b], and A′=f on (a,b)
statement.natural_language: 连续函数的定积分等于任一原函数在两端点取值之差。
statement.scope: Continuous-integrand Newton-Leibniz form.

material_status.basis: Classical finite-dimensional implicit function theorem.

statement.conclusion: There are neighborhoods V of a and W of b and a unique C¹ map g:V→W with F(x,g(x))=0, and every nearby zero has y=g(x).
hypotheses: F:U⊆R^n×R^m→R^m is C¹
D_yF(a,b) is invertible
statement.natural_language: 若方程 F(x,y)=0 对 y 的偏导在解点可逆，则解集局部唯一地是 C¹ 图 y=g(x)。
statement.scope: Finite-dimensional C1 graph form.

material_status.basis: Classical finite-dimensional inverse function theorem.

statement.conclusion: There are neighborhoods V of a and W of f(a) such that f|_V:V→W is a C¹ diffeomorphism and D(f|_V)^{-1}(f(x))=(Df(x))^{-1}.
hypotheses: U⊆R^n is open
f:U→R^n is C¹
a∈U
Df(a) is invertible
statement.natural_language: C¹ 映射在导数可逆的点附近是 C¹ 微分同胚。
statement.scope: Finite-dimensional C1 version.

material_status.basis: Classical Lebesgue differentiation theorem.

statement.conclusion: For almost every x, lim_{r→0} |B(x,r)|^{-1}∫_{B(x,r)}|f(y)−f(x)|dy=0, hence the averages of f converge to f(x).
hypotheses: f∈L¹_loc(R^n)
statement.natural_language: 局部可积函数在几乎处处的点等于其缩小球平均值的极限。
statement.scope: Euclidean balls and Lebesgue measure.

material_status.basis: Alaoglu's weak-topology compactness theorem.

statement.conclusion: B is compact.
hypotheses: X is a real or complex normed space
B carries the weak-star topology σ(X*,X)
statement.natural_language: 赋范空间对偶的闭单位球在弱星拓扑下是紧的。
statement.scope: Closed dual unit ball; no reflexivity assumption.

material_status.basis: Classical conjugation-action class equation.

records.preferred_label: Class equation of a finite group

hypotheses: G is a finite group
x₁,…,x_r represent the noncentral conjugacy classes
C_G(x_i) is the centralizer
statement.natural_language: 有限群的阶等于中心的阶加上各非中心共轭类大小之和。
statement.scope: Finite groups only.

material_status.basis: Classical group isomorphism theorem.

statement.conclusion: The map g kerφ↦φ(g) is a well-defined group isomorphism G/kerφ≅imφ.
hypotheses: φ:G→H is a group homomorphism
statement.natural_language: 群同态的定义域模其核同构于其像。
statement.scope: Groups; ring/module analogues are separate variants.

material_status.basis: Classical group-action theorem.

statement.conclusion: The map G/G_x→G·x, gG_x↦g·x, is a bijection; hence |G·x|=[G:G_x], and if G is finite then |G|=|G_x||G·x|.
hypotheses: G acts on a set X
x∈X
G_x={g∈G:g·x=x}
statement.natural_language: 群作用中一点的轨道与其稳定子的左陪集集合自然双射；有限情形轨道大小等于稳定子指数。
statement.scope: Set actions; cardinal/index statement includes the finite corollary.

material_status.basis: Classical second isomorphism theorem.

statement.conclusion: HN≤G, N◁HN, H∩N◁H, and h(H∩N)↦hN gives an isomorphism H/(H∩N)≅HN/N.
hypotheses: H≤G
N◁G
statement.natural_language: 若 H 是 G 的子群、N 是 G 的正规子群，则 H/(H∩N) 同构于 HN/N。
statement.scope: Standard subgroup-normal-subgroup version.

material_status.basis: Classical third isomorphism theorem.

statement.conclusion: H/N◁G/N and (G/N)/(H/N)≅G/H by the canonical map.
hypotheses: N◁G
H◁G
N⊆H
statement.natural_language: 若 N 包含于 H 且二者都是 G 的正规子群，则 (G/N)/(H/N) 同构于 G/H。
statement.scope: Groups; normality of H in G is explicit.

material_status.basis: Standard measure-extension theorem with the uniqueness hypothesis made explicit.

statement.conclusion: There exists a unique measure μ on σ(A) with μ restricted to A equal to μ₀.
hypotheses: A is an algebra of subsets of Ω
μ₀:A→[0,∞] is a premeasure
μ₀ is σ-finite
statement.natural_language: 代数上的 σ-有限预测度唯一扩张为其生成 σ-代数上的测度。
statement.scope: Existence-plus-uniqueness variant; σ-finiteness is imposed for uniqueness.

material_status.basis: Classical analytic class number theorem.

statement.conclusion: Res_{s=1} ζ_K(s)=2^{r₁}(2π)^{r₂}h_KR_K/(w_K√|d_K|).
hypotheses: K is a number field with signature (r₁,r₂)
h_K,R_K,w_K and d_K denote its class number, regulator, number of roots of unity and discriminant
statement.natural_language: 数域 K 的戴德金 ζ 函数在 s=1 的留数由类数、调节子、单位根数和判别式给出。
statement.scope: Full number-field formula under the standard regulator normalization.

material_status.basis: Classical theorem; the cited formal reference exposes a checked exact statement.

statement.conclusion: There exist a,b,c,d∈Z with n=a²+b²+c²+d².
hypotheses: n is a nonnegative integer
statement.natural_language: 每个非负整数都是四个整数平方之和。
statement.scope: Zero is allowed; some of the four integers may be zero.

material_status.basis: Gelfand-Naimark representation theorem.

statement.conclusion: There exist a Hilbert space H and an injective isometric *-homomorphism A→B(H) whose image is norm closed.
hypotheses: A is a C*-algebra
statement.natural_language: 每个 C* 代数都有一个到某个希尔伯特空间上有界算子代数的忠实等距 *-表示。
statement.scope: General, possibly noncommutative representation theorem.

material_status.basis: Commutative Gelfand representation theorem.

statement.conclusion: The Gelfand transform A→C(Δ(A)) is an isometric *-isomorphism.
hypotheses: A is a commutative unital C*-algebra
Δ(A) is its character space with the weak-star topology
statement.natural_language: 每个含幺交换 C* 代数经盖尔范德变换等距 *-同构于其特征空间上的连续函数代数。
statement.scope: Unital commutative variant; locally compact nonunital form is separate.

material_status.basis: Classical Glivenko-Cantelli theorem.

statement.conclusion: sup_{x∈R}|F_n(x)−F(x)|→0 almost surely.
hypotheses: X₁,X₂,… are i.i.d. real random variables with distribution function F
statement.natural_language: 实值独立同分布样本的经验分布函数几乎必然一致收敛到真实分布函数。
statement.scope: Classical one-dimensional empirical-CDF form.

material_status.basis: Kolmogorov consistency/extension theorem.

statement.conclusion: There exists a unique probability μ on the product cylinder σ-algebra whose finite-dimensional marginals are μ_J.
hypotheses: I is an index set
each E_i is a standard Borel space
for every finite J⊂I a probability μ_J on ∏_{j∈J}E_j is given
the μ_J are projectively consistent
statement.natural_language: 标准 Borel 状态空间上的相容有限维分布族唯一确定乘积柱 σ-代数上的概率测度。
statement.scope: Standard-Borel version; completion and path regularity are separate questions.

material_status.basis: Classical information inequality under explicit regularity assumptions.

statement.conclusion: Var_θ(T)≥(g′(θ))²/I(θ).
hypotheses: {p_θ} is a regular dominated one-parameter model with θ-independent support
differentiation may pass under the integral
T is square-integrable and E_θ[T]=g(θ)
statement.natural_language: 在正则单参数模型中，g(θ) 的任意无偏估计量的方差至少为 (g′(θ))²/I(θ)。
statement.scope: Scalar unbiased-estimation form; biased and matrix forms are separate variants.

material_status.basis: Fisher 1922 is retained as historical provenance; the Halmos-Savage Radon-Nikodym treatment supports the modern dominated-experiment scope of the factorization criterion.

statement.conclusion: T is sufficient for Θ iff there exist measurable g_θ and a nonnegative measurable h independent of θ such that f_θ(x)=g_θ(T(x))h(x) μ-a.e. for every θ.
hypotheses: the sample space is standard Borel
Θ is finite or countable
{P_θ:θ∈Θ} is dominated by a σ-finite measure μ with densities f_θ
T is measurable
statement.natural_language: 在可数参数的受控统计模型中，统计量 T 充分当且仅当各密度可分解为只经 T 依赖样本的参数项与参数无关项之积。
statement.scope: Countably indexed dominated version, chosen so simultaneous density versions are well-defined.

material_status.basis: Classical Gauss-Markov BLUE theorem.

statement.conclusion: Cov(Ay)−Cov((XᵀX)^{-1}Xᵀy) is positive semidefinite.
hypotheses: y=Xβ+ε with deterministic n×p matrix X of rank p
Cov(ε)=σ²I_n with finite σ²
an estimator Ay is linear and unbiased for β, so AX=I_p
statement.natural_language: 在满列秩、同方差且误差不相关的线性模型中，普通最小二乘是协方差意义下最佳的线性无偏估计量。
statement.scope: Classical homoscedastic uncorrelated full-rank linear model.

material_status.basis: Lehmann-Scheffe completeness theorem.

statement.conclusion: U is the unique (up to model-null equality) uniformly minimum-variance unbiased estimator of τ among square-integrable unbiased estimators.
hypotheses: T is complete and sufficient for {P_θ}
U=g(T) is square-integrable
E_θ[U]=τ(θ) for every θ
statement.natural_language: 完备充分统计量的任意平方可积无偏函数是目标参数的唯一一致最小方差无偏估计量。
statement.scope: UMVU form; completeness and exact estimand are explicit.

material_status.basis: Neyman-Pearson's primary result.

statement.conclusion: Every test of size at most α has H₁-power no greater than the likelihood-ratio threshold test.
hypotheses: H₀ and H₁ are simple dominated hypotheses with densities p₀ and p₁
the likelihood-ratio test randomizes on a boundary if needed to have size α
statement.natural_language: 检验两个简单假设时，在给定显著性水平内，似然比阈值检验是最强力检验。
statement.scope: Simple-versus-simple hypotheses; composite extensions are separate results.

material_status.basis: Classical theorem in the cited primary paper.

statement.conclusion: There exists x∈S^n such that f(x)=f(−x).
hypotheses: n is a positive integer
f:S^n→R^n is continuous
statement.natural_language: 每个连续映射 f:S^n→R^n 都在一对对跖点取相同值。
statement.scope: Euclidean n-sphere and finite-dimensional real codomain.

material_status.basis: Classical topological theorem.

statement.conclusion: There exists x∈S^{2n} with v(x)=0.
hypotheses: v is a continuous tangent vector field on S^{2n}
statement.natural_language: 每个偶维球面上的连续切向量场至少有一个零点。
statement.scope: Even-dimensional spheres; odd-dimensional spheres have nowhere-zero tangent fields.

material_status.basis: Brouwer's invariance-of-domain theorem.

statement.conclusion: f(U) is open in R^n and f:U→f(U) is a homeomorphism.
hypotheses: U⊆R^n is open
f:U→R^n is continuous and injective
statement.natural_language: 欧氏 n 维空间开集到同维欧氏空间的连续单射是开映射，并且是到其像的同胚。
statement.scope: Equal finite dimensions; codomain dimension is exactly n.

material_status.basis: Classical Jordan curve theorem.

statement.conclusion: R²∖C has exactly two connected components, one bounded and one unbounded, and C is the boundary of each.
hypotheses: C⊂R² is the image of a continuous injective map S¹→R²
statement.natural_language: 平面中的每条简单闭曲线把平面恰分成两个连通分支，并且曲线是两者的共同边界。
statement.scope: Topological Jordan curves; no smoothness assumption.

material_status.basis: Classical planar Schoenflies theorem.

statement.conclusion: There exists a homeomorphism H:R²→R² whose restriction to S¹ (under the standard inclusion) equals h.
hypotheses: h:S¹→R² is a topological embedding
statement.natural_language: 平面中的任意简单闭曲线嵌入都可扩张为整个平面的自同胚。
statement.scope: Planar Schoenflies extension; stronger than plane separation alone.

material_status.basis: Breuil, Conrad, Diamond and Taylor prove modularity for every elliptic curve over Q, completing the semistable case.

records.preferred_label: Modularity theorem for elliptic curves over Q (exact variant)

statement.conclusion: There exists a normalized weight-2 cuspidal newform f of level Γ₀(N_E) such that a_p(f)=p+1−#E(F_p) for every prime p not dividing N_E.
hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve over Q
N_E is the conductor of E
statement.natural_language: 每条定义在有理数域上的椭圆曲线都对应一个权 2、级别等于其导子的归一化新形式。
statement.scope: All elliptic curves over Q; the displayed equality is asserted at every good prime and fixes the modularity meaning used here.

material_status.basis: Roth's 1955 paper proves the exponent-two finiteness theorem in this scope.

statement.conclusion: Only finitely many fractions p/q satisfy |α−p/q|<q^(−2−ε).
hypotheses: α is a real irrational algebraic number
ε is a positive real number
p and q are coprime integers with q>0
statement.natural_language: 对任意无理代数数 α 与任意 ε>0，不等式 |α−p/q|<q^(−2−ε) 只有有限多个既约有理解。
statement.scope: Real rational approximation to an irrational algebraic number; the combinatorial Roth theorem is a distinct family.

material_status.basis: Blum's primary JACM paper proves the machine-independent speedup theorem; the cited abstract-complexity reference exposes the quantified almost-everywhere form used here.

records.preferred_label: Blum speedup theorem — exact almost-everywhere form

statement.conclusion: There exists a total computable predicate g:N->{0,1} such that, for every i with phi_i=g, there exists j with phi_j=g and r(x,Phi_j(x))<=Phi_i(x) for all but finitely many x.
hypotheses: (phi_i) is a fixed effective numbering of the partial computable unary functions
Phi is a Blum complexity measure for that numbering: Phi_i(x) is defined exactly when phi_i(x) is defined, and the predicate Phi_i(x)=m is decidable in (i,x,m)
r:N x N -> N is total computable
statement.natural_language: For every Blum complexity measure (phi,Phi) and every total computable two-argument speedup function r, there is a total computable predicate g such that every index i computing g has another index j computing g with r(x,Phi_j(x)) at most Phi_i(x) for all but finitely many x.
statement.scope: The almost-everywhere comparison means all natural-number inputs except a finite set. The theorem asserts existence of a speedup-bearing predicate for each r; it does not say that every computable function lacks an optimal program.

material_status.basis: Rado's primary paper fixes the two-symbol blank-tape model and proves the noncomputability and domination behavior of the Busy Beaver functions.

records.preferred_label: Rado step Busy Beaver S(n) domination theorem — exact convention

statement.conclusion: S is not computable, and for every total computable f:N->N there exists N such that S(n)>f(n) for every n>=N.
hypotheses: n>=1; a machine has n nonhalting working states plus one distinguished halt state, one bi-infinite tape, symbols {0,1}, blank symbol 0, and starts in the first working state on an all-0 tape
For each working-state/symbol pair the deterministic transition writes 0 or 1, moves one cell left or right, and enters a working state or the halt state
S(n) is the maximum number of executed transitions before first entering the halt state among all such n-state machines that halt
statement.natural_language: Under Rado's n-state, two-symbol, blank-tape convention, the maximum halting step count S(n) is noncomputable and eventually exceeds every total computable numerical function.
statement.scope: This is Rado's step/activity function S(n). The productivity function Sigma(n), which maximizes the number of printed 1 symbols, is a separate variant.

material_status.basis: The cited Rao and Blackwell sources establish conditional-expectation improvement; the finite-dimensional integrability and common-kernel hypotheses make the conditional Jensen step explicit.

records.preferred_label: Rao–Blackwell theorem for R^d-valued estimators — exact convex-loss form

statement.conclusion: For every theta, E_theta[L(theta,delta_star(T))] <= E_theta[L(theta,delta(X))].
hypotheses: (X,A,{P_theta}) is a statistical model on a standard Borel sample space and T:X->Y is measurable into a standard Borel space
T is sufficient in the explicit kernel sense: there is one Markov kernel K(dx|t), independent of theta, that is a regular conditional distribution of X given T=t under every P_theta
delta:X->R^d is Borel measurable and E_theta[||delta(X)||]<infinity for every theta
For every theta, a->L(theta,a) is a finite nonnegative convex Borel function on R^d and E_theta[L(theta,delta(X))]<infinity
delta_star(t)=integral delta(x) K(dx|t), defined componentwise (equivalently as the finite-dimensional Bochner integral)
statement.natural_language: 在标准 Borel 统计模型中，用充分统计量的参数无关条件核对 R^d 值可积估计量取条件均值，在非负有限凸损失下不增加风险。
statement.scope: Finite-dimensional R^d-valued estimators with an explicitly shared sufficient kernel. Strict improvement, infinite-dimensional Banach-valued estimators and losses lacking the stated integrability require separate variants.
